ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface (>90%) with discrete, localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters (<10%) indicating high global contrast but low overall white-to-black surface area ratio.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with irregular amplitudes (sharp peaks and deep valleys) extracted along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tilted distal tips.
